description: Golden recall tasks for preference memory, factual memory, and retrieval synthesis.

cases.prompt: Remind me which day-planning style I said works best for me.
expected_behaviors: Prefer durable preference recall over generic planning advice.
Signal uncertainty if the memory match is weak.
Tie the recalled preference back to the current question.
disallowed_behaviors: Hallucinate a preference without memory support.
Return raw retrieval snippets with no synthesis.
